classification_model.rule: Indicators in the objective and self-report lanes remain comparable to their own baseline and target, but Jichi Insight must not collapse both lanes into a single undifferentiated achievement score without an explicit methodology that preserves measurement-type differences.

records.name_ja: 合計特殊出生率
records.comparison_boundary: Population statistic; do not interpret it as a citizen-perception response.

records.name_ja: 20～29歳の道外への転出超過数（日本人のみ）
records.comparison_boundary: Population movement statistic; distinct from self-reported intention or satisfaction.

records.name_ja: 18歳以下の子がいて、妊娠・出産や子育てについて相談相手や情報収集手段がある親の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Target-group self-report; not equivalent to an administrative count of consultation services.

records.name_ja: 希望に応じた保育サービスが利用できた保護者の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Reported experience of service access; keep separate from facility capacity or waiting-list statistics.

records.name_ja: 自分の目標をもって生活している子どもの割合
records.comparison_boundary: Child/student self-report; not an administrative education attainment measure.

records.name_ja: まちのバリアフリー化が進んでいると感じる市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Perceived progress; must not be presented as a direct inventory of barrier-free infrastructure.

records.name_ja: 高齢者・障がいのある方等の立場を理解して行動ができている人の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Self-assessed attitude/behavior; not direct observation of inclusive behavior.

records.name_ja: 市民の健康寿命
records.comparison_boundary: Derived health statistic with male/female dimensions; not a self-rated health survey percentage.

records.name_ja: 生涯学習をしている市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Participation is self-reported; do not substitute course enrollment administrative counts.

records.name_ja: デジタル化が進んでいると実感している市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Perceived digitalization; distinct from online-procedure counts or system deployment counts.

records.name_ja: １人乗りが可能な除雪機械台数
records.comparison_boundary: Administrative equipment count; no respondent perception component.

records.name_ja: 社会的役割を感じる市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Subjective sense of social role; not equivalent to observed volunteering or employment.

records.name_ja: 市民まちづくり活動に参加したことのある人の割合
records.instrument_reference: 札幌市市民意識調査・地域活動の参加経験に関する調査群
records.comparison_boundary: Participation experience is survey-reported; not an organization membership administrative count.

records.name_ja: 災害に対する備えを行っている市民の割合
records.instrument_reference: 札幌市市民意識調査・災害への備えに関する調査群
records.comparison_boundary: Preparedness behavior is self-reported; not a direct inspection of household stockpiles.

records.name_ja: 人口一人当たりの市内総生産（名目）
records.comparison_boundary: Macroeconomic statistic; not a perception or business-sentiment survey.

records.name_ja: 冬期（12～３月）の観光客数
records.comparison_boundary: Tourism-volume statistic; methodology may combine multiple tourism data sources and should not be treated as a citizen survey.

records.name_ja: 札幌市内での総観光消費額
records.instrument_reference: 札幌市観光産業経済効果調査（観光客消費アンケート＋産業連関分析）
records.comparison_boundary: An economic estimate derived from visitor survey inputs and analysis; not a direct administrative revenue total and not a citizen-perception measure.

records.name_ja: 就業率
records.comparison_boundary: Labor statistic; distinct from self-reported job satisfaction or employment intention.

records.name_ja: スポーツ（運動）をする市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Self-reported activity behavior; not facility-use attendance counts.

records.name_ja: 文化芸術活動への参加割合
records.comparison_boundary: Self-reported cultural participation; not ticket sales or venue attendance administrative totals.

records.name_ja: 市有施設等における温室効果ガス排出量

records.name_ja: ごみや資源回収に関することについて満足している市民の割合
records.comparison_boundary: Citizen satisfaction; do not substitute waste tonnage, recycling rate, or service-call counts.

records.name_ja: 都心の区域内実容積率
records.comparison_boundary: Built-environment statistic; no survey respondent component.

records.name_ja: 地域交流拠点の区域内実容積率
records.comparison_boundary: Built-environment statistic; no survey respondent component.

quality_boundary: All 26 reviewed outcome identities now have an explicit measurement lane and family. The registry separates subjective/self-reported perceptions, experiences, and behaviors from objective administrative/statistical measures and from survey-derived economic estimates. Exact instrument provenance is intentionally left pending for indicators where only the measurement family is currently supported; those gaps do not block the measurement-separation boundary. Existing source-reported trend arrows and numerical values are not changed.
